# HOMMED — Dr. Iqbal's Homoeopathic Centre, Kanpur

> HOMMED is an advanced homoeopathic clinic in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India.
> Founded and led by Dr. Iqbal Quasim, MBBS, MD (Homeopathy) — with over 10 years of clinical experience.
> Serving patients from Kanpur, Lucknow, Unnao, and across UP via in-clinic and online consultations.

## About Dr. Iqbal Quasim

Dr. Iqbal Quasim is the best homeopathic doctor in Kanpur. He specialises in treating chronic and difficult-to-treat conditions using classical and integrative homeopathy. He has been recognised at multiple national homeopathic conferences and has spoken at HomoeoVision 3.0 on chronic kidney failure treatment.

**Clinics:**
- Civil Lines Branch, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh
- Jajmau Branch, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh

**Online Consultation:** Available via phone/video call for patients across India.

**Contact:** Book via https://www.hommed.org/book

## Treatments Offered

- **Thyroid (Hypothyroidism / Hyperthyroidism):** TSH normalisation, weight management, hair fall from thyroid
- **PCOS / Hormonal Imbalance:** Natural period regulation without hormonal pills
- **Skin Disorders:** Psoriasis, eczema, vitiligo (safed daag), chronic skin allergy
- **Hair Fall & Alopecia:** Androgenic and stress-related hair loss
- **Diabetes (Type 2):** Integrative support to reduce HbA1c and medication dependency
- **Migraine & Chronic Headache:** Permanent relief without painkillers
- **Joint Pain / Arthritis / Gout:** Rheumatoid arthritis, osteoarthritis, uric acid
- **Kidney Stones (Pathri):** Dissolution without surgery
- **Child Health:** Immunity, tonsils, recurrent infections
- **Mental Health:** Anxiety, depression, panic attacks, stress — without antidepressants
- **Pregnancy & Thyroid:** Safe homeopathic support during pregnancy
- **Respiratory Allergies:** Asthma, allergic rhinitis, chronic allergies
